evidence.context:
The International Conference on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing (ICASSP), is the IEEE Signal Processing Society’s flagship conference on signal processing and its applications. The 52nd edition of ICASSP will be held in the dynamic city of Toronto, Canada; one of the most multicultural and cosmopolitan cities in the world. The programme will include keynotes by pre eminent international speakers, cutting-edge tutorial topics, and forward looking special sessions. ICASSP also provides a great networking opportunity with a wide range of like-minded professionals from academia, industry and government organizations.
